title: C-77: a ban before sign-in shows why login was refused
notes: The driver creates the disposable account before these steps.
The console ban precedes the first authentication attempt; the client log identifies its ban message as GUI_AccountBannedTime.
The ban dialog is captured directly because its taller message does not match the existing invalid-login crop.
server_log_allowed: Character creation: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
ban the account before its first sign-in
the client sends its authentication request
the server reads the authentication message
the server refuses the banned account
steps.pattern: failed to authenticate as {user}: the account is banned; sent MSG_USER_AUTHEN_RSP Error=(\S+)

steps.name: the client receives a non-success response
the client chooses a refusal message
the client shows why the account was refused
the client is never admitted or sent to character select
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user|WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the server never authenticates the banned account
